subject: store/copr: partly revert pr/35975, do it correctly this time (#55196)
summary: Reviewed this commit vs first parent: it removes the incorrect KeepOrder concurrency cap in `pkg/store/copr` (based on `KeyRanges.PartitionNum()` which collapses to 1 for non-partitioned tables) and reintroduces KeepOrder-specific tuning in `pkg/distsql/RequestBuilder.Build()` based on DAG shape. No remaining Blocker/High issues found in correctness/consistency/session-store semantics; later upstream history further refines the KeepOrder override behavior (e.g. respecting non-default `@@tidb_distsql_scan_concurrency`).
